Subject: Field scan & QBR prep: pricing ripples + model-release flags

Team — quick field scan ahead of next week’s QBR prep session. I’m attaching a loose deck and a price matrix; please review and feed updates by EOD Monday so we can lock slides. High-level flags below (short and actionable).

What changed (last 72h):
- IonAI published a public price adjustment: ~35% reduction for token-based pricing on their base-generation endpoints (announcement: public blog + curbed enterprise discounts). Early telemetry: pressure on net-new demo-to-deal conversion in startup accounts.
- NimbusCloud announced a managed inference offering with a 99.9% SLA and a bundled 8-bit quantized LlamaX variant targeted at mid-market (packaged with integrated VPC peering). Pricing not public for enterprise yet, but their messaging is: simpler procurement + SLA.
- LlamaX upstream (community) pushed a 4-bit quantized release note that some smaller infra teams are already testing — quality drop is model/seed dependent but cost delta looks attractive.

Implications for QBR / OKRs:
- Sales OKR (Renewals / Expansion): short-term risk in low-touch renewals and some late-stage deals. We need to call out competitive pricing pressure and our counter-levers (dedicated capacity discounts, caching/quantization playbook, preferred routing).
- Product OKR (Serve reliability & differentiation): emphasize our fallback routing & predictable latency as a counter to Nimbus’s SLA messaging. Add a small bench of benchmarks (p99 latency across workloads) to the QBR appendix.
- GTM messaging: avoid price-matching narratives; instead, double down on operational predictability + cost-per-query savings via our Optimize recommendations.

Asks (owners & deadlines):
- Markus: add two anonymized win/loss vignettes and a 1-slide pipeline impact estimate (ARR at risk) — due Mon 12/07 EOD.
- Laura: pull p99 latency and cost-per-token deltas for the two customer segments (startup vs enterprise); include one short quote from a CS contact if we have it — due Mon 12/07 noon.
- Aditya: flag 3 live deals that could be affected and mark suggested MITIGATION steps in each mutual action plan — due Mon 12/07 EOD.
- Rishi: can you check SOC/compliance stickiness bullets in the deck (we should call them out for enterprise procurement objections)? Confirm by Mon 12/07 4pm.

Attachments: qbr_field_scan_v1.pdf, competitor_price_matrix_202612.csv, qbr_deck_draft_v3.pptx

Thanks — short and sharp here; we’ll synthesize into the QBR master deck after your inputs.

—
